fact: As at September 2026 Kenya has no AI-specific statute in force; the Court of Appeal narrowed the Computer Misuse and Cybercrimes Act in March 2026, and in February 2026 a student charged over an AI-generated image of a funeral procession was acquitted at Milimani Law Courts.
title: AI in Kenya's Judiciary and Law Enforcement | Tools, Training, and Regulations | AI Atlas
